primary.title: The stock market just got crushed. Why Citi is raising its S&P 500 target.
primary.summary: Citi strategist Scott Chronert lifted his year-end S&P 500 target to 8100, arguing that strong earnings growth and AI spending continue to outweigh macroeconomic risks.
